title: DON'T GIVE UP, God is Preparing You For Something Much Better (Christian Motivation)
paragraphs: life is said to be like a school the more we live the more lessons we learn some lessons can be tough like a strict teacher who isn't afraid to teach the hard way you may trip or fall that each time this happens you should remember that you're learning and you're never alone in your struggles God is always there is watching you with patient eyes helping you grow and getting you ready for the grand future he has in mind for you God

is with you during your struggles so don't give up during difficult times God offers comfort and Hope he provides deliverance from all your troubles in Psalm 34 verses 17 to 18 the Bible says the righteous cry out and the Lord hears them he delivers them from all their troubles the Lord is close to the Brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit let us look again at The Familiar story of Jonah Jonah a man who was given a direct task

by God chose to run away from his responsibilities he boarded a ship going in the opposite direction hoping to escape God's call but God in his infinite wisdom and omnipresence didn't let Jonah off that easily God sent a storm causing the crew to throw Jonah overboard where he was swallowed by a large fish inside the belly of the fish Jonah had plenty of time to reflect on his actions he prayed repenting for his Disobedience and was eventually released from the fish

from then on Jonah chose to obey God's call he went to the city of Nineveh to Warn its inhabitants about God's Wrath if they continued in their Wicked Ways as reluctant as Jonah was he played a significant part in turning a city towards repentance now Jonah's story teaches us that no matter how much we try to run away from our responsibilities or struggles they will eventually catch up with us but it is through these struggles that God refines us teaching us

important lessons and preparing us for something better we must not give up even when the task seems too daunting or when we would rather be swallowed by a giant fish than face our troubles now let's turn to another known biblical character Esther her story can be found in the Book of Esther chapters 1 to 10. Esther was an ordinary Jewish girl who was chosen to be the queen of a powerful Persian king when her people were threatened with Annihilation Esther had

a choice to make she could have remained silent enjoying the comfort of her Palace but she decided to risk her life and speak out with prayer and fasting she approached the king revealed her identity and pleaded for the lives of her people the king granted her request her people were saved and the one who plotted against them was punished Esther could have given up thinking that she was just an ordinary girl who could do nothing but she chose to act and

God used her to bring about a significant Victory Esther's story is a testament to how God can use anyone to accomplish his purposes it doesn't matter who you are where you come from or what you've done when God has a plan for you he will use all situations even the challenging ones to prepare you for something much better the narrative is clear here don't give up because God often uses our struggles our challenges and our trials to prepare us for something

much better he doesn't promise US an easy Journey but he assures us of an amazing destination the Bible tells us in First Peter 5 verse 10 and after you have suffered a little while the God of all Grace who has called you to his eternal glory in Christ will himself restore confirm strengthen and establish you this verse is a powerful reminder that our current trials are only for a while but God's glory is eternal he is using our current situation to

prepare us to restore us to confirm us to strengthen us and to establish us just don't give up the story of Jonah teaches us not to run away from our troubles but to face them with faith knowing that God is using them to prepare us for a better future while the story of Esther shows us that no matter who we are God can use us to accomplish great things if we trust in him and never give up in your life you

may face hardships setbacks and disappointments there may be times when you feel like giving up but remember this God is telling you not to give up because he is preparing you for something much better he is there with you in every step guiding you teaching you and shaping you into the person he wants you to be the path may be challenging the journey may be long but the Final Destination the Glorious future God has prepared for you is worth it hold

on to this promise let it give you strength when you are weak hope when you are down and courage when you are afraid so when the road seems long and hard do not give up when the mountain seems too high to climb do not give up when the valley seems too deep to cross do not give up when the night seems too dark and the storm too strong do not give up remember God is telling you not to give up because

he is preparing you for something much better I really believe that in the name of Jesus I speak the blessings of Jeremiah 29 verse 11 over your life for I know the plans I have for you declares the Lord plans to prosper you and not to harm you plans to give you hope and a future may we all be like Jonah learning from our struggles and coming out stronger may we be like Esther using our position no matter how insignificant it

seems for the good of others and above all may we always remember that God is with us preparing us for something much better never give up dear friends hold on to God's promises trust in his plan and know that he is preparing you for something much better let this be the message that resonates in your hearts and Minds today and every day of your life do not give up for God is preparing you for something great now to all those within

the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to our gracious and faithful God Heavenly Father our loving and gracious God I humbly come to you now with an open heart I thank you for your Endless Love your endless mercy and your endless Grace that you pour upon me every day Lord I Thank You For

Life even when it seems difficult I thank you for the sunshine but also for the rain I thank you for Joy but I also thank you for every situation that you use to teach me mold me and prepare me for something better Lord I admit that sometimes I feel tired sometimes I may even feel like I can't go on but revive Me O Lord and Deliver Me from the spirit of discouragement the journey may seem long the mountain may seem high

the valley seems deep but in these moments Lord remind me of your promises may you whisper to me that you are telling me not to give up because you are preparing me for a better tomorrow father may you help me to see my troubles as teachers teaching me strength help me to see my failures not as endpoints but as chances to learn and to try again when I feel weak Lord give me strength whenever I feel lost may you be my

guide whenever I feel afraid may you give me courage whenever I feel like giving up may you remind me of your promises to give me hope in a future Lord help me to learn from my mistakes may you help me to keep going keep trying to keep believing in your promises in my daily life Lord may you remind me that every step I take every move I make you are there with me help me to feel your presence and remind me

that you are never far away Lord teach me patience teach me to wait for your perfect timing teach me to trust in your perfect plan and whenever I get impatient when I start to question may you help me to remember that you are God and you know what is best for me Father help me to keep my eyes on you Lord not on my problems not on my pain but on you and your promise For You Are My Hope my strength

and my guide you are the reason I keep going you are the reason I do not give up Lord as I wait upon you help me to live my life in a way that pleases you help me to be kind to be loving and to be patient help me to spread your love Wherever I Go Lord I pray for reconciliation peace love and harmony in my relationships with my loved ones Lord I Thank you that everything is working for me and

not against me Lord I Thank you that no weapon that is formed against me shall prosper and Lord I Thank you that those that are with me are more than those that are against me father I pray for your peace which surpasses all understanding I ask for your Divine protection for me and my loved ones Lord I pray for renewed hope health and strength merciful father I thank you for all increase in all favor and I am grateful that your goodness

and mercy shall follow me Lord as I say this prayer together with everyone listening for every person opening their heart to you right now I ask that you fill them with your love and holy spirit for anyone dealing with hurt or pain Lord may you be their comforter for anyone who needs strength to get through today Lord I ask that you give them the strength to go on for anyone who may be thinking about giving up Lord may they feel your

presence and your love and may you give them your peace and hope Lord may you bring calm to the worried hearts may you bring gladness to those that are sad may you bring Clarity to those that are confused may you bring healing to those that are sick Lord may you meet each person at their point of need and bring them Deliverance through our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ I thank you Lord for hearing my prayer and for everyone listening I trust

in you Lord and I will not give up we will not give up in the name of Jesus I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen in the comment section below you can help us to reach more persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member and by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart

and uplift your spirit we appreciate all your support you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer request in the comments section so that we can present them before God for your blessings and victory and so that other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world can stand in agreement with you right now to God be all the glory I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of
Jesus May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all foreign
